# Quill 2.0.3

Pinned browser assets from the official `quill@2.0.3` npm package:
`https://registry.npmjs.org/quill/-/quill-2.0.3.tgz`.

`quill.js`, `quill.core.css`, and `LICENSE` are vendored unchanged. No runtime
CDN request, package installation, or build step is required. Source maps are
not shipped. The notebook uses only bold, italic and list formats; clipboard
input is converted through the local restricted adapter, never raw user HTML.
